title: GET /api/decks returns ALL decks to any authenticated reader
description: The collection query applies no caller-derived predicate, so every authenticated principal receives the identifiers and metadata of every other principal's decks.

title: Build output bypasses publish-link verification
description: The build-output route serves deck bytes to anyone presenting a valid deck UUID and a signed access token. Exploitable only if the deck UUID is known and the URL can be signed, neither of which is the case for an outsider.

title: SHA-1 used for a non-security cache key
description: Reachable by the same persona but contributes nothing to the deck-content chain. Must NOT be escalated — this is the precision control against the reference implementation, which escalated every reachable finding.

title: Deck URL signing key echoed into the build log
description: The signing key is interpolated into a debug line that ships to the build log. Asserted LOW in isolation — the analyst reasoned that a log line is not a vulnerability by itself. It is the third leg of the deck-content chain, and the uncapped R3 rung is what turns that reasoning around: LOW -> CRITICAL in one step, which a ±1 cap could never express.
